title: Risk Review and Account Integrity
provenance: Authored for the RefundFlow offline simulation; this text is not copied from external services.
license_notes: Synthetic demo text; not legal advice.
excerpts: Risk review checks for inconsistent order, payment, and account signals before a consequential refund recommendation is presented for approval.
A mismatch between account ownership and the order evidence requires human review. Do not expose another customer's account or transaction details.
Repeated or conflicting refund claims may be routed for a second review. A risk flag is a request for investigation, not proof of fraud or grounds for an automatic denial.
Record only the minimum case evidence needed for review. Remove unnecessary personal information from notes and never collect passwords or full payment credentials.
